scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic; exact-rational exhaustive computations are supplemental. Standard marked-block and Stirling counting ingredients are credited. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite covariance sign theorem applies to uniform set partitions into exactly k >= 3 blocks, n >= k+2, and size s >= 2. The macroscopic cutoff holds at fixed k only. No broader stochastic ordering is asserted. Older conditional occupancy literature and the English version of Timashev (2003) leave residual priority uncertainty.
title: Singleton–block dependence has one sign transition in fixed-block set partitions
